A Reality-Breaking Portal Effect Made in Unity

#News#Unity#VFX

The effect was made for an upcoming game Desolus.

Game Developer Mark Mayers demonstrated an absolutely mind-blowing effect made in Unity. This time, the developer has managed to set up a space-shattering portal VFX that can teleport you to the same location but from a different time period. According to the developer, the effect will be used in the upcoming Desolus game in which you will need to explore a Gothic city torn between universes.
